Compared with S02-WC-073's 'the location of the individual using our Services'; 'you must comply with the laws of the jurisdiction of your business and your customers' and 'how the laws in your region, and the region in which you sell, might affect your business' (S02-SH-733, on customer privacy): the business's jurisdiction and the merchant's region, in the decider's role; its customers' and the region it sells in are kept out (second pass, RD1-S2); 'If you're located in or sending marketing messages to countries in the European Union, then your store must be compliant with the ePrivacy Directive' (S02-SH-953) and the same for the United Kingdom's 'Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations' (S02-SH-954): where the merchant is located, in the decider's role; sending to those countries is kept out (second pass, RD1-S2)
scope: Enhanced Services (Appendix E) (S02-SH-623); New merchants in Europe (S02-SH-625); Shopify Messaging, SMS marketing campaigns; stores located in or sending marketing messages to countries in the European Union (S02-SH-953); Shopify Messaging, SMS marketing campaigns; stores located in or sending marketing messages to the United Kingdom (S02-SH-954)

variant: If you are located in Canada or the United States, your Personal Data is received by: Shopify Inc.
basis_evidence: 'If you are located in Canada or the United States, your Personal Data is received by: Shopify Inc.' and 'If you are located in the EEA, the UK, the Middle East, South America, or Africa, your Personal Data is received by: Shopify International Ltd.' (S02-SH-617, the Privacy Policy's 'How you can reach us'); 'If you are located in the EEA, the UK, or Switzerland, your Personal Data is received by our Irish affiliate, Shopify International Ltd.' (S02-SH-616): where the person whose Personal Data it is is located decides which Shopify company receives it; my reading: the Privacy Policy's 'you' includes the merchant, so the merchant's location is in the decider's role, as part RD1-4 read S02-WC-073's 'the location of the individual using our Services' (S02-V-221)
scope: people located in the EEA, the UK, or Switzerland (S02-SH-616)

variant: pricing and payment options can differ depending on where your business is based
basis_evidence: 'Some features vary by country ... so pricing and payment options can differ depending on where your business is based' (S02-SH-612, the FAQ of Shopify's pricing page, 'In what countries can I use Shopify?'): where the business is based, in the decider's role, decides the pricing of Shopify's plans; compared with S02-SH-248's 'Changing your store's country might affect ... Your subscription fees'

variant: Your Shopify Payments account must be located in one of the following countries
basis_evidence: 'Your Shopify Payments account must be located in one of the following countries' (S02-SH-630, Przelewy24 for Shopify Payments) and '... in one of the following regions' (S02-SH-633, MB WAY; S02-SH-637, Bizum), and 'If your Shopify Payments account is in Poland, then your domestic currency must be set to PLN or EUR. If your account is in any other eligible country, then you must have a market for Poland' (S02-SH-631): the location of the merchant's Shopify Payments account decides the payment methods the store can offer through Shopify Payments; in the decider's role as a record of where the merchant's business is (a reading: to use the Payments Services 'you must be a business located in your Designated Country', S02-SH-016); 'If you use Shopify Payments in Japan, then you're required to have a legal notice containing information for the Specified Commercial Transactions Act' (S02-SH-825, scope 'Japan (Shopify Payments in Japan)'): the country of the merchant's Shopify Payments, in the decider's role (a reading, as above) (second pass, RD1-S2)
scope: Przelewy24 for Shopify Payments (S02-SH-630, S02-SH-631); MB WAY for Shopify Payments (S02-SH-633); Bizum for Shopify Payments (S02-SH-637); Japan (Shopify Payments in Japan) (S02-SH-825)

variant: SMS notifications are supported only when your business address is in one of the following countries
basis_evidence: 'SMS notifications are supported only when your business address is in one of the following countries' and 'If your business isn't in a supported country, then you can only offer email notifications to customers' (S02-SH-870); 'if your business address is in a supported country, then customers who enter a phone number ... will receive their order confirmation by SMS' (S02-SH-869): the business address, a record that holds the store's own country, in the decider's role, decides the SMS notifications the store can use; compared with S02-SH-248's 'Your access to Shopify products and services'

variant: The entity assigned to each retail location determines the currency for Shopify POS at that location
basis_evidence: 'Multiple business entities: The entity assigned to each retail location determines the currency for Shopify POS at that location' (S02-SH-921, scope 'Shopify POS; stores with multiple business entities'): a business entity, in the decider's role, decides a currency of the store; compared with S02-SH-248's 'The local language and currency for your store'
scope: Shopify POS; stores with multiple business entities

variant: Cash rounding rules might apply automatically at checkout depending on your store's location
basis_evidence: 'Cash rounding rules might apply automatically at checkout depending on your store's location and when you opened your store in a particular country. Some rules apply to all stores in specific countries.' (S02-SH-935, scope 'Shopify POS'): the store's location, in the decider's role, decides a rule the platform applies automatically; when the store opened is its other decider; compared with S02-SH-248's 'The local language and currency for your store'
scope: Shopify POS

variant: There are no specific country requirements for your store's location
basis_evidence: every store: 'There are no specific country requirements for your store's location, as long as it meets the requirements for sending SMS marketing campaigns' (S02-SH-956, scope 'Shopify Messaging, SMS marketing campaigns'): SMS marketing campaigns are offered whatever the store's country; the customers' countries it can send to are kept out
scope: Shopify Messaging, SMS marketing campaigns
